name: postgres-release-isolation-r5a
proved: migration and compatibility history have immutable configured hard caps checked before expansion and cutover
worker image ID and labels bind the exact worker code and the artifact digest from the existing operator registry
the container recomputes the registry digest from the exact executed operator source before becoming ready
worker environment has no platform DSN, token, password, secret, credential, or AWS variables
worker has no Docker socket, host proc mount, or platform PostgreSQL network reachability
untrusted RPC computation alone cannot mutate PostgreSQL cursor, state, or outputs
the platform rejects forged artifact result identity and oversized or malformed results
failure after worker computation but before the platform transaction leaves cursor and output unchanged; exact retry commits once
execution-attempt replacement fences the old owner before another terminal publication
limits: the Docker daemon, platform process, host kernel, and image builder are trusted
the accepted profile is closed-network and supports one pinned uppercase operator artifact
external connector credentials are not passed to isolated operators and connector execution is unsupported
general container escape resistance and multi-tenant hostile-kernel isolation are not claimed
this evidence does not replace the separate PostgreSQL HA storage evidence
